usageNotes: Use this to inventory all LVM thin pools on a specific node before creating or resizing a thin-provisioned storage pool in Proxmox. Requires the Sys.Audit privilege at the root path (/). The node must be online; the call targets the local LVM subsystem of that node and will fail if the node is unreachable.

examples.summary: List all LVM thin pools on node pve1

tips: Each result includes both lv (thin pool LV name) and vg (volume group), which together form the storage identifier used when adding LVM-thin storage via the datacenter storage config (e.g. vg/lv).
Monitor metadata_used vs metadata_size — if metadata fills up, the thin pool will stop accepting writes even if data space remains.
lv_size and used are in bytes; divide by 1073741824 for GiB display.
